segments.name: Banking
segments.description: Accepts deposits from the public and makes loans and other investments through its bank in Alabama, Florida, Georgia and other states.
segments.evidence: Our business is conducted through a single reportable segment, and our principal business is to accept deposits from the public and to make loans and other investments.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers pay interest and fees on loans, and the bank also earns interest, dividends and service charges on other investments.
revenueModel.evidence: Our principal sources of income are interest and fees collected on loans, interest and dividends collected on other investments, and service charges.
